label: Can off-hand hits proc Windfury Totem?
short: Main-hand hits only, per client 70425's description.
description: Forever's totem is a raid aura, but client 70425's description says "Each main hand hit has a 20% chance", as in Era.
source: Forever client 70425 (totem description). User ruling 2026-10-16.

settings.label: Main hand only
settings.value: only main-hand hits can proc it

label: How often does raid damage hit a DPS?
short: Each hit can fire a shield, give Rage or push back a cast.
description: Every DPS takes 2 hits a minute of 1500 damage, from boss timers. They take no health but fire Lightning Shield orbs (one per 3.5s) or Water Shield globes, give a warrior Rage and Enrage (about 3.4 Rage a hit) and push back casts.
source: SoD boss timers in Deadly Boss Mods (Ragnaros, Broodlord, Firemaw, Chromaggus, Huhuran, Kel'Thuzad, Sapphiron).

label: Do bosses partly resist spells by level?
short: Classic bosses resisted about 6% of spell damage. Beta mobs above us resisted none.
description: Classic bosses partly resisted about 6% of spell damage. About 520 beta hits on mobs 3 to 5 levels up showed none, and no boss is tested yet.
source: Beta logs (0 partials in about 520 hits at +3 to +5). Classic's level rule (royalgiraffe's resist guide).

settings.label: Bosses keep it (6% at +3)
settings.value: Classic's 2% average partial resist per level above you, on bosses only
settings.rationale: The only way to fit the beta's 0 in 520.

label: How hard do bleed ticks crit?
short: Bleeds can crit under Forever. Nobody has seen a bleed tick crit's size.
description: The sim uses 200%, like a melee crit. The only measured tick crits are spell ticks, at 150%.
source: Client 70425 (periodic crit on bleeds). Shaman beta logs (Flame Shock at 1.5x).

label: Does Rage from hits grow with level?
short: Rage per hit was measured to level 30. Growth to 60 is unknown.
description: Rage per hit by weapon speed was measured to level 30. Kept flat at 60, a swing gives about half of Classic's Rage.
source: Blizzard's Priest & Warrior deep dive. Level 30 beta tests (forum thread 2355684). Model: Rage = k × weapon speed, k(L) = k30 × (1 + s × (L − 30) / 30).

settings.label: Flat (level 30 value)
settings.value: Rage per hit stays at its level 30 value

label: Do off-hand hits give full Rage?
short: Half the Rage of a main-hand hit of the same speed, from a beta log.
description: A beta log shows a 1.6s off-hand dagger giving 2.7 to 2.8 Rage a swing, half a main-hand swing, glancing blows included. Dual Wield Specialization's 10% a point adds to it.
source: Arlewow's combat log (gist a622100ad149f4fc31ddf95f9b3aab2c, magey/forever-warrior issue 3, level 13). User ruling 2026-10-16.

label: How much attack power does Rend get?
short: Blizzard says Rend scales strongly with attack power. The client has no number.
description: Blizzard says Rend scales strongly with attack power, but the client has no number. The presets add 2% of attack power a tick.
source: Blizzard's warrior notes. Forever client 70338.

settings.label: Small (2% a tick)
settings.rationale: About 14% of attack power over a full Rend.

label: Do our stances change Rage from hits taken?
short: Blizzard didn't say about stances, Shield Wall, Recklessness or blocks.
description: Rage from damage taken ignores our armor and absorbs, and counts crits and crushing blows. The presets assume no modifier counts.
source: Blizzard's 8 October notes (post 5) and the Forged in Battle article.

settings.label: All count
settings.value: our damage taken modifiers scale the Rage

settings.label: None count
settings.value: the attacker's hit, before anything of ours

settings.label: Only increases
settings.value: Berserker Stance and Recklessness add Rage, reductions take none

label: Rage from a hit taken at 60
short: Fitted on level 8 logs from before the 8 October fix.
description: The sim gives K × (1 − assumed armor) × damage / a normal mob's health at our level. K = 20 fits the level 8 to 9 logs. K = 48 matches Classic for a 50% armor warrior, against a level 60 normal mob's 5356 health.
source: magey/forever-warrior issue 3. Blizzard's 8 October notes.

label: How much does the pet inherit?
short: 10% of ranged attack power, measured to level 30. The hunter's hit is unknown.
description: The pet gets 10% of ranged attack power (measured to level 30). Blizzard says it also gets the hunter's hit, with no number, and the sim gives all of it, as SoD did.
source: ForeverChanges' hunter pets page and the forever-hunter wiki (attack power). Blizzard's 17 September known issues (hit).

settings.label: 10% AP, no hit
settings.value: 10% of ranged attack power, none of the hunter's hit

settings.label: 10% AP + hit

settings.label: 22% AP + hit (SoD)
settings.value: 22% of ranged attack power plus the hunter's hit

label: Do fast pets hit as hard as slow pets?
short: On the beta every pet hits like a 2.0s pet. The presets treat it as a bug.
description: On the beta every pet hits like a 2.0s pet, so the 1.0s cat deals the most. The presets use Classic's rule, where a fast pet's hits are smaller.
source: Beta players (ForeverChanges' hunter pets page, forever-hunter wiki).
